# P4 — Apple Apps (SwiftUI · Apple HIG · macOS + iOS/iPadOS)

The native Apple clients at full web parity, using **SwiftUI**, Swift 6, **Swift Charts**,
**MapKit**, and the **Apple Human Interface Guidelines**. One SwiftUI codebase targets
**macOS + iOS + iPadOS** (adaptive layouts), consuming the **KMP shared core** as an
`.xcframework` (ADR-004) wrapped in a Swift-friendly facade.

> Prereqs: P1/S99 DONE. Branch `feat/apps-apple` (ADR-007). **Requires macOS + Xcode runners**
> (ADR-010/012) — prompts that can't run their gate are BLOCKED, not DONE. Read
> ADR-002/004/005/008/009/011/015. Page prompts (P7) generated by P1/S0-0002 into `p4-apple/pages/`.

## Phases

| Phase | Theme | Prompts | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| **P0** | Workspace setup | `P0-0001..` | Xcode workspace, macOS + iOS targets, SPM deps, `shared.xcframework` integration, CI green |
| **P1** | Shared facade | `P1-0001..` | Swift facade over the KMP xcframework (ergonomic async/await, Observation), golden-vector parity |
| **P2** | Design system | `P2-0001..` | `Tokens.swift` from `apps/design` (Color/Font/material), light/dark, Dynamic Type |
| **P3** | Component library | `P3-0001..` | SwiftUI equivalents of web shared components (GlassPanel→`.regularMaterial`, StatCard, Swift Charts wrappers, MapKit wrapper, EmptyState, Redacted/shimmer) |
| **P4** | App structure + nav | `P4-0001..` | `NavigationSplitView`/`TabView` adaptive shell (sidebar on macOS/iPad, tabs on iPhone), routing, deep links |
| **P5** | Auth + onboarding | `P5-0001..` | OIDC PKCE via `ASWebAuthenticationSession`, Keychain (+ optional biometric), onboarding |
| **P6** | Live data + APNs | `P6-0001..` | SSE binding (foreground), APNs registration + notification handling, Live Activities where apt (ADR-009) |
| **P7** | **Pages (generated)** | `pages/**` | every web page at parity, HIG-native, adaptive across macOS/iOS/iPadOS |
| **P8** | Platform polish | `P8-0001..` | menus/commands (macOS), widgets (WidgetKit), App Intents/Shortcuts, Handoff, settings |
| **P9** | Tests | `P9-0001..` | XCTest + XCUITest (each parity unit's states) + snapshot tests on both idioms |
| **P99** | Apple acceptance gate | `P99-0001` | parity ledgers 100% (apple-macos + apple-ios), gates green, archives sign |

## Binding rules for P4

1. Allowed files scoped to `apps/apple/**` (+ `apps/design/generated/apple/**` for P2).
2. **HIG-native + adaptive**: one SwiftUI view layer adapts to macOS (sidebar, menus, pointer),
   iPad (split view, multitasking), iPhone (tabs). No web pixel-cloning; use native materials,
   not hand-rolled glass. No placeholder screens (ADR-011).
3. Views are driven by `@Observable` view models wrapping the **shared-core state holders** via
   the Swift facade (P1). No networking/business logic in the Apple module.
4. The parity ledger tracks **two** targets (`apple-macos`, `apple-ios`); a page is DONE only
   when it satisfies parity on **both** idioms (adaptive layout counts, not two codebases).
5. P7 page prompts are GENERATED; each satisfies its embedded `=== PARITY ===` + placeholder gate.

## Exit criteria

- `xcodebuild build test` (macOS + iOS Simulator) green; SwiftLint --strict + SwiftFormat --lint clean.
- `apps/parity/apple-macos-ledger.json` + `apps/parity/apple-ios-ledger.json` both 100%.
- Archives sign for both platforms; `P99` log `STATUS=DONE`.
